desc: Convert each point to a perimeter coordinate using side-specific mapping, handling corners.
Implement a feasibility function that, for a given \(d\), computes `nxt[i]` (next index with gap \(\ge d\)) and tests each start with up to \(k-1` jumps, checking the interval bound.
Binary search on integer \(d` from 0 to \(4 \times \text{side}` to find the maximum feasible distance.
Write the final `Solution.maxDistance` method integrating all steps.
Test with provided examples and edge cases.
